SELECT 
  HI_GROSS_EXP_TBL.PP_END_YEAR, 
  HI_GROSS_EXP_TBL.PP_NUM, 
  HI_GROSS_EXP_TBL.EMPL_ID, 
  HI_GROSS_EXP_TBL.CAN, 
  HI_GROSS_EXP_TBL.TK_NO, 
  HI_GROSS_EXP_TBL.DIFF, 
  MIN(CPM_PM3_STG_TBL.PYF_GEN_SEQ_ID) 
FROM
   HI_GROSS_EXP_TBL, 
   CPM_PM3_STG_TBL 
WHERE HI_GROSS_EXP_TBL.DIFF <> 0
        AND CPM_PM3_STG_TBL.PP_END_YEAR            = HI_GROSS_EXP_TBL.PP_END_YEAR
        AND  CPM_PM3_STG_TBL.PP_NUM                         = HI_GROSS_EXP_TBL.PP_NUM
        AND  CPM_PM3_STG_TBL.PYF_REC_NO_PDT3 = '3'
        AND  CPM_PM3_STG_TBL.PYF_EYE_ID_PDT3    = HI_GROSS_EXP_TBL.EMPL_ID
        AND  CPM_PM3_STG_TBL.PYF_ACTUAL_AMT IN (HI_GROSS_EXP_TBL.DIFF,
                                                                                                                 HI_GROSS_EXP_TBL.DIFF * - 1,
                                                                                                                 HI_GROSS_EXP_TBL.DIFF /2,
                                                                                                                 (HI_GROSS_EXP_TBL.DIFF / 2) * -1)
                                                                                                            
GROUP BY 
      HI_GROSS_EXP_TBL.PP_END_YEAR, 
      HI_GROSS_EXP_TBL.PP_NUM, 
      HI_GROSS_EXP_TBL.EMPL_ID, 
      HI_GROSS_EXP_TBL.CAN, 
      HI_GROSS_EXP_TBL.TK_NO, 
      HI_GROSS_EXP_TBL.DIFF
ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT 
		a.ERROR_MESSAGE, 
		a.SOURCE_KEY, 
		a.ERROR_DATE, 
		a.PP_END_YEAR, 
		a.PP_NUM, 
		a.CYCLE_ID, 
		a.ERROR_CODE 
FROM
		ERROR_TBL a,

	(SELECT
			b1.PP_END_YEAR,
			b1.PP_NUM,
			MAX(b1.ERROR_DATE) as ERROR_DATE,
			MAX(b1.CYCLE_ID) as CYCLE_ID
          FROM
			ERROR_TBL b1
	   WHERE
			b1.ERROR_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
	   AND
			b1.PP_END_YEAR = TO_NUMBER('$$MAP_PP_END_YEAR')
	   AND
			b1.PP_NUM = TO_NUMBER('$$MAP_PP_NUM')
	   AND
			b1.CYCLE_ID = $$MAP_CYCLE_ID
	   AND
			b1.PROCESS_NAME = 'm_CPM_AFPS_0400_Crossfoot_Errors'
	  GROUP BY
			b1.PP_END_YEAR,
			b1.PP_NUM) b

WHERE
		a.ERROR_DATE = b.ERROR_DATE
AND
		a.PP_END_YEAR = TO_NUMBER('$$MAP_PP_END_YEAR')
AND
		a.PP_NUM = TO_NUMBER('$$MAP_PP_NUM')
AND
		a.CYCLE_ID = b.CYCLE_ID
AND

ORDER BY
